title: Ask Users for Information
description: GOV.UK one-question-per-page form: error summary, labelled input with hint, and submit button.

components.reason: Rendered at the top only when validation fails; focus moves here
Carries the question as label, the hint, and the error message — the prerequisite for every input
The answer field; instantiate inside the order-2 form group
Submit; the only primary button on the page

nesting: Component 3 sits inside component 2 (label + hint + input); component 4 follows the form group; component 1 sits above everything when present
validationOrder: Question text is in the label, not a separate heading
Every input is inside a govuk-form-group with a for/id-linked label
On failure: error-summary at top, govuk-form-group--error + govuk-error-message on the field, focus moves to the summary
a11yNotes: One question per page keeps the h1 equal to the question
agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the form group and place the question label, hint, and input inside it
2. Add the submit button after the form group
3. On validation failure, prepend the error summary and wire error links to input ids
